verdict.rationale: Column's own reporting feature exports `bank_account_transaction` and `bank_account_summary` reports in open formats (CSV, JSON, Parquet). Its documented API exposes transfers across all payment types and raw wire messages, and it produces monthly statements, so core financial data can be pulled out. However, the reports cover only those two types, and no complete account-wide export or documented offboarding/exit path is shown. Missing for 10: a documented full-data export covering all object types (entities, cards, loans, events), documented account closure/migration guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of export completeness.
